mechanism: generationRef increments on wallet/chain scope change; AbortController aborts prior commit path; commits require vm.generation === generationRef.current && !signal.aborted
note: Portfolio data is composed from PoolsRuntimeContext (not a dedicated fetch in the hook). AbortController cancels commit into last-good cache rather than HTTP.

example.guard: generation match && not aborted && state in ready|partial|empty

example.rule: only if module cache has no positions
